subject: POC acceptance scrubline + action assignments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@crestline-analytics.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@crestline-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC acceptance scrubline + action assignments

Hi Emily / Carlos,

Quick MAP checkpoint after yesterday's call — I'm outlining the current acceptance items we need to close inside the trial window (see attached small-redline MAP and the evaluation checklist). High-level status:

- Eval harness: custom dataset ingestion working, but sample size gap (we need 10k vs current 2.5k) — blocker for final quality gate.
- Latency: average p99 on your sample sessions is 320ms (meets target for dev tier but we want <250ms for production).
- Data isolation: private VPC proof-of-concept is provisioned; pending org-level review from your security team.

Proposed immediate actions (owners and ETA):
1) Crestline to provide anonymized 10k sample payloads (owner: Emily) — target: 2026-07-19 EOD
2) Redwood infra to run quantized inference sweep and report p99 improvements (owner: Karthik) — target: 2026-07-16 noon PT
3) Legal/procurement to prepare standard trial addendum for extended telemetry (owner: Marissa) — target: 2026-07-15
4) Security Q&A outcome: Crestline to confirm allowed telemetry columns and retention (owner: Carlos) — target: 2026-07-18

Meeting note highlights (from 2026-07-13 call):
- Crestline clarified acceptance criteria: F1 > 0.78 on named-entity extraction, p99 latency < 250ms, and no cross-tenant KV leakage in cached requests.
- Redwood requested the acceptance runbook to include exact prompt templates and seed conversations.

Attachments included: crestline_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with line-level owners), redwood_eval_checklist.pdf (eval gates and scripts).

If this plan looks right I will convert the spreadsheet lines into a mutual action plan (MAP) in shared Drive and kick off the acceptance-run job once we get the 10k sample.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: POC acceptance scrubline + action assignments

Thanks Jordan — clear and helpful. Quick updates:

- We can get to a 10k anonymized sample, but it will be a phased upload. First batch ~3k by 2026-07-16, remainder by 2026-07-19. Carlos will coordinate the SFTP/secure upload.
- On telemetry columns, security flagged hashed user_id and session_timestamp as acceptable; they still want clarification on any device fingerprinting. We'll have the security note back by 2026-07-18 as requested.
- On latency: we can tolerate a slightly higher p99 during evaluation as long as production SLAs are met on the final run. But prefer to see Karthik's quantization sweep results before we sign off.

Action: Carlos will share SFTP credentials in a follow-up and Emily will confirm the phased upload schedule.

Emily Ross
Head of Data Science | Crestline Analytics
emily.ross@crestline-analytics.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC acceptance scrubline + action assignments

Quick update from infra/testing: we completed an initial quantization sweep (INT8 profile) against the 2.5k sample. Results: p99 improved from 320ms -> 240ms on the same instance class (g5.12x). We observed a small delta in NER F1 (~0.6% drop) on the eval harness.

Planned next steps:
- Run the same sweep on the full 10k once Crestline uploads it. Estimate runtime: 3 hours.
- I'll attach a short runbook to the MAP with the exact commands used, and a comparison sheet.

Open blocker: we need the phased upload (3k) to run the INT8 check before pushing to the remaining 7k to avoid repeating runs unnecessarily. If Crestline can do the first batch by Friday morning PT we can have the initial report by Friday noon.

Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
(attachment stub: quant_sweep_notes.md — text, 6KB)

Thanks everyone — good momentum. Summarizing owners, deliverables, and the next checkpoint: 

Action items (finalized):
- Crestline: phased upload of anonymized dataset (3k by 2026-07-16 AM PT; remaining 7k by 2026-07-19 EOD) — owner: Emily / Carlos
- Redwood infra: run INT8 sweep on 3k batch and share result (target: 2026-07-16 noon PT) — owner: Karthik
- Redwood legal: draft trial telemetry addendum and circulate (target: 2026-07-15) — owner: Marissa
- Crestline security: confirm telemetry columns and device fingerprint policy (target: 2026-07-18) — owner: Carlos
- Jordan: convert line items into MAP in Drive and tag each line with HubSpot deal id (DEAL-9817) — target: 2026-07-16 EOD

Next checkpoint: brief sync on 2026-07-19 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — agenda: review INT8 report, confirm security Q&A, and decide go/no-go for final acceptance run. I'll share a calendar invite.

If anyone needs to escalate a blocker before then, loop me or Sean and we'll triage.

Best,

Jordan
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
